user.title: Network
user.description: The Zhongshan Water portal ([smartbi.zsws.com.cn]({portal_url})) resolves to an unreachable IPv6 address on some networks, which shows up as a connect timeout. If login keeps failing, come back here and pick "IPv4 only".

login_type.title: Login method
login_type.description:
Choose how to sign in:

- **Password**: the phone number and password of your portal account, plus a graphic captcha. Most reliable.
- **WeChat**: open the portal from the 中山公用水务 WeChat official account and paste the `unionid` from the address bar.
- **SMS registration**: if you have no portal account yet, create one with a phone number and an SMS code.

password_login.title: Password login
password_login.description:
Sign in with your Zhongshan Water portal account.

**Graphic captcha**: first [open the captcha image]({captcha_url}), then type the digits below. It is valid for 5 minutes and can only be viewed once; if you mistype it, just submit again to get a fresh one.

wechat_login.title: WeChat login
wechat_login.description:
1. Follow the 中山公用水务 official account in WeChat and open the portal via 在线服务 → 查询缴费 (or the [web portal]({portal_url})).
2. Copy the part of the address bar that starts with `unionid=`.
3. Paste it below — pasting the whole URL that contains `unionid=` works too.

data.unionid: unionid or full URL containing one

sms_register.title: SMS registration
sms_register.description:
The portal does **not** support signing in with an SMS code alone; the code is only used to register an account.

An SMS code will be sent now. On the next screen, enter the code and your new password to finish registering and sign in automatically. Afterwards you can also use the password login.

sms_register_code.description: A code was sent to {mobile}. Enter the 6-digit SMS code to finish registering.

bind_account.title: Bind a new account
bind_account.description:
Bind a water account that is not registered yet. Enter the account number, the account holder name and the phone number registered against the meter; the portal will text an SMS code to that number.

If binding fails here, bind it in the [web portal]({portal_url}) or in the 中山公用水务 WeChat account first, then use "Add bound accounts".
